top.title: DIGGER x ClipFarm
top.description: Make clips for DIGGER, the new Tom Cruise dark comedy from Warner Bros., in theaters now. Use the approved footage to make the funniest, weirdest or most surprising edits you can, and get people curious enough to buy a ticket.
top.brief: Digger follows Digger Rockwell, an enormously wealthy and powerful oil tycoon whose drilling empire sets off a devastating environmental catastrophe. As the disaster threatens the world, Digger frantically tries to convince everyone that he's the one who can save humanity, even though his own actions helped cause the crisis. The chaos escalates into a dark satire about greed, power, politics, and humanity's careless treatment of the planet. Then the film pulls its biggest twist. Much of what we've been watching turns out to be Fossil Fools, a stage play dramatizing a real disaster from decades earlier, with Tom Cruise playing Curtis Markson, an actor portraying Digger in a revival. As opening night approaches, the people behind the production wrestle with their own personal struggles. When Digger's symbolic downfall plays out at the climax, the film snaps back to reality: the real world outside the theater has been devastated by environmental collapse. It's a darkly comic story about greed, climate destruction, and humanity's habit of creating the disasters it later tries to escape.
